evaluation.hallucination_trigger: Bilingual Latin-Greek Patrologia page with two dense columns. Printed text, clear type. The bilingual format with extensive patristic content provides rich stylistic context for generation. The large page with small type has maybe 4,000 chars of actual text.
errors: Lite generates fluent patristic Greek and Latin far beyond page content
evaluation.notes: Patrologia Graeca pages are well-represented in training data, making fabrication particularly convincing. The bilingual format doubles the stylistic options for generation.
